Bl.bar_b_note: Flat magenta floor decals, a murky one-value forest with no purple storm sky or lightning, and a HUD covering a third of the frame sink it.

Es.bar_b_note: Sparse, empty plateaus with flat grey-rain or moon-blue grades lack Palworld's density and Valheim's fog, shafts and lamp-lit nights.

To.bar_b_note: Same images as Es: sparse plateaus and flat night grades keep it short of Palworld/Valheim finish.

Qr.bar_b_note: A lone flat-infill panel beside a placeholder-grey boulder falls short of Palworld's base-building finish.

Jl.bar_b_note: An appealing, expressive stylised elder in a fitting palette carries it.

Vr.bar_b_note: A's floating plastic-banded faint poses and B's muddy mottling on a bare stage don't reach Palworld's creature finish.

top_changes.change: Real lightning or web strike effects with impact flashes in place of magenta decals, fight camera kept out of canopy, Stormwood purple sky and lightning grade
Dress the Cloudreach stands with foreground and midground props, villagers and planted edges; warm lamps and unblown windows over a moon-blue fill; one architecture family
Glowing-vein colour blocks on the Fulgocobra with grounded faints; textured infill and real thickness on the homestead wall
